data.name: Smita
data.gender_notes: Smita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Smita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Smriti', which means 'recall, remember'. In Hindu mythology, Smriti is the goddess of memory and learning, who is believed to help preserve the ancient texts and traditions. The name Smita carries the meaning “Recall, remember” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Smita usually hope their child will grow to embody recall, remember and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of memory and the importance of preserving knowledge and tradition.
data.etymology: Smita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Recall, remember.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Smita total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
